text:
Several power banks support Qi2.2 25W wireless charging. These are the ones in the search results:

**Available to buy in the US**
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10,000 mAh)**: Qi2.2-certified with up to 25W wireless charging and a 45W USB-C port. It works with the iPhone 16 and 17 series and the Pixel 10 Pro XL ([Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Baseus-launches-new-Qi2-2-25W-certified-10-000-mAh-power-bank-with-slim-design.1223437.0.html)). It lists at $79.99 on Amazon and $59.99 on Baseus's site. A tested code, AM52, takes $6 off for $53.99 ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/baseus-discount-codes)). Buy: [Baseus PicoGo AM52](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w). This is an affiliate link that opens Baseus's official US store, and Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you.
- **Anker MagGo 2 Pro (10,000 mAh)**: Qi2.2 25W with active cooling, a built-in fan, a display and stand, and 45W USB-C. It costs $109.99, but it's currently a pre-order shipping Oct 21 to Nov 9, 2026. Anker lists it as compatible with Apple devices only (iPhone 13 through 17, except the 16e). Buy: [Anker MagGo 2 Pro](https://www.anker.com/products/a110r-qi2-maggo-2-pro-magnetic-power-bank?Sort_by=Recommended&collections_anker-earth-day-sale-2026=&variant=46550444277910).

**Qi2 25W, but I couldn't confirm purchase details**
- **ESR MagSlim (10,000 mAh)**: 13.8 mm thick and described as the thinnest Qi2 25W power bank. It was previewed at CES 2026, and ESR says it's sold on Amazon and its own site. The press release gave no price or direct product link ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/esr-expands-its-qi2-25w-wireless-charging-lineup-advancing-everyday-charging-at-ces-2026-302653572.html)). It's worth searching for on Amazon or ESR's site, and I'd confirm it's now in stock.
- **UGREEN MagFlow 25W**: The first Qi2.2-certified power bank, planned for Amazon and UGREEN's site ([UGREEN press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ugreen-pioneers-next-gen-wireless-charging-with-magflow-25w-the-worlds-first-qi-2-2-certified-power-bank-302505385.html)). I only have the 2025 announcement, with no current price or product page.

**Not for the US**
- **CIO SMARTCOBY Ex05 Wireless2.2 Pro (10,000 mAh)**: Qi2.2 25W, but it's sold in Japan for ¥8,980 ([PR TIMES](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000665.000043212.html)).

If you want the best value and can get it now, the Baseus PicoGo AM52 is the cheapest confirmed option. If you'd rather have active cooling and can wait for shipping, the Anker MagGo 2 Pro is the premium pick.
